pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: Rocky
work.note: Rocky (1976) é um drama esportivo dirigido por John G. Avildsen e escrito por Sylvester Stallone, que também faz o papel principal. Rocky Balboa é um boxeador pouco conhecido da Filadélfia que recebe a chance de enfrentar o campeão dos pesos-pesados, Apollo Creed. O contexto da obra ajuda o estudante a usar hoje você aprende persistência: Do not give up! Carry on! Keep going. A champion never gives up em uma situação

facts.label: Passado em andamento
facts.sub: Use was ou were + verbo com -ing para contar o que você estava fazendo: I was cooking dinner. Pergunte What were you doing? e responda com Yes, I was ou No, I wasn’t.

facts.label: Passado em andamento
facts.sub: Para falar de uma ação em andamento no passado, use was ou were + verbo com -ing: I was cooking dinner. We were watching TV. Diga o horário: at six last night.

facts.label: Perguntas
facts.sub: Para perguntar, coloque was ou were antes da pessoa: Were you sleeping? Was it raining? Com What: What were you doing? A resposta curta é Yes, I was ou No, I wasn’t.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Was/were + -ing talks about an action in progress in the past.
“Were you sleeping?” is a correct question.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Was/were + -ing talks about an action in progress in the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I were cooking”. → Falso (We say I was cooking.)
“Were you sleeping?” is a correct question. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A busy cafe · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in a cafe in Boston. The smell of coffee fills the room. Tom sits near the window. His friend Rita sits down with a cup of tea. She tried to call him last night. Now she wants to know the story.
“Hi, Tom! What were you doing at six last night?” says Rita. “I was cooking dinner at home.” says Tom. “Really? I called your phone. Were you sleeping?” says Rita.
